question: Who among the following won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**England**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• England won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2022 by defeating Pakistan in the final match.
 
• The final was held on November 13, 2022, at the Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG), Australia.
 
• England successfully chased a target of 138 runs set by Pakistan, winning the match by 5 wickets.
 
• Sam Curran of England was named the Player of the Tournament for his exceptional performance throughout the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ICC Men's T20 World Cup**

 
 
• The ICC Men's T20 World Cup is an international championship of Twenty20 International cricket organized by the International Cricket Council (ICC).
 
• The tournament consists of 16 teams, including the top 10 teams from the ICC T20 rankings and 6 other teams chosen through the T20 World Cup Qualifier.
 
• The T20 format is known for its fast-paced and exciting nature, with each team playing a single innings of 20 overs.
 
• The ICC Men's T20 World Cup has been held since 2007, and it is typically played every two years.
 
 
 
• **Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG)**
 
 
• The Melbourne Cricket Ground, also known simply as the MCG, is an iconic sports stadium located in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia.
 
• It is one of the largest stadiums in the world, with a seating capacity of over 100,000.
 
• The MCG has a rich history and is known for hosting major sporting events, including cricket matches, Australian rules football, and the Olympic Games.
 
• The stadium is often referred to as the "G" and is a symbol of Australian sports culture.
 
 
 
• **Sam Curran**
 
 
• Sam Curran is an English cricketer who plays for the England national team and various domestic cricket teams.
 
• He is an all-rounder, known for his left-arm medium-fast bowling and left-handed batting.
 
• In the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2022, Curran played a crucial role for England, taking important wickets and contributing valuable runs.
 
• His outstanding performances earned him the Player of the Tournament award.
